ym_instance.label: Yandex account source
ym_instance.description: Borrow the Yandex account of a configured Yandex Music provider (single sign-in for the whole household) or use this plugin's own sign-in.

label_auth_borrowed.label: Using the Yandex account of the linked Yandex Music provider. Sign-in is managed there; nothing is stored or rotated by this plugin.

clear_auth.label: Sign out of Yandex
clear_auth.description: Clears the cached Yandex Passport x_token. The registered skill stays in Yandex Dialogs; sign in again to manage it.

label_auth_intro.label: Sign in to Yandex to register a dialog skill on your behalf. We never see your password — Yandex hands us a long-lived x_token only after you confirm a verification code in the popup window.

sign_in.label: Sign in to Yandex Passport
sign_in.description: Starts the Yandex Passport Device Flow in a popup window. After confirming the code, the form refreshes.

dialog_skill_name.label: Skill name
dialog_skill_name.description: At least 2 words. Globally unique across all Yandex skills. Examples: 'Music Assistant', 'My Music', 'Home Audio'.

dialog_skill_name_edit.label: Skill name (activation phrase #1)
dialog_skill_name_edit.description: At least 2 words. This is the activation phrase users say to Alice to invoke your skill.

dialog_skill_name_advanced.label: Skill name
dialog_skill_name_advanced.description: The skill's display name in Yandex Dialogs.

external_base_url_advanced.label: External base URL (HTTPS)
external_base_url_advanced.description: Public HTTPS URL Yandex calls for webhooks. Editable here even after the skill is registered.

test_webhook_reachability.label: Test webhook reachability
test_webhook_reachability.description: Sends a sentinel POST to the webhook URL and reports the result. Catches DNS / TLS / reverse-proxy issues *before* you spend a Yandex moderation cycle on a broken setup.

label_skill_resume.label: ⏸ Setup was interrupted. Click 'Continue setup' to resume from step {0}.

auto_create_continue.label: Continue setup
auto_create_continue.description: Resumes the skill creation pipeline from the last completed step.

auto_create_retry.label: Try again
auto_create_retry.description: Retries the skill creation pipeline from the last completed step.

auto_create_start.label: Create skill
auto_create_start.description: Pre-checks Yandex for an existing skill with the same name; if found, prompts to Recreate or Adopt. Otherwise registers a fresh skill.

label_skill_failed_manual.label: Manual fallback: open https://dialogs.yandex.ru/developer in your browser and create the skill yourself with webhook URL {0}{1}/<webhook secret>. Once the skill is created, paste its Skill ID into the Advanced section below.

cancel_dialog_skill_flow.label: Reset and start over
cancel_dialog_skill_flow.description: Drops partial setup state and clears the failed flag. Cached Passport sign-in is kept.

label_skill_intro.label: Click 'Create skill' to register a new dialog skill in your Yandex Dialogs account. The external base URL above must be a public HTTPS URL.

label_skill_dup_intro.label: ⚠ A skill named «{0}» already exists in your Yandex Dialogs account. Choose how to proceed:

label_skill_dup_recreate_hint.label: • Recreate — delete the existing skill and register a fresh one with the same name.

label_skill_dup_adopt_hint.label: • Adopt — keep the existing skill and re-deploy it against this Music Assistant's webhook URL.

recreate_duplicate.label: Recreate (delete + create fresh)
recreate_duplicate.description: Deletes the existing skill in Yandex and registers a fresh one.

adopt_existing.label: Adopt existing skill
adopt_existing.description: Keeps the existing skill and re-deploys it against this MA's webhook.

pub_status_on_air.label: ✅ Yandex moderation passed — your skill is on air. Voice commands routed via Alice will now reach this skill on your Yandex Station.

pub_status_in_moderation.label: ⏳ Yandex moderation in progress (typically 5-15 min). Click Refresh status below to re-check.

pub_status_rejected.label: ❌ Yandex moderation rejected the latest deploy. Open the dev console to see the rejection reason and edit the skill, then click Update skill to re-submit.

pub_status_draft.label: ⚠️ Skill is registered but has never been published. Click Update skill (or re-deploy via Recreate) to submit it to Yandex moderation.

pub_status_unknown.label: ℹ️ Publication status not yet fetched — click Refresh status to query Yandex Dialogs.

label_skill_dev_console_url.label: Yandex Dialogs dev console
label_skill_dev_console_url.description: Copy this URL and open it in your browser.

edit_skill.label: Edit skill
edit_skill.description: Reveals editable fields for the skill name, alternative activation phrases, and TTS voice.

refresh_status.label: Refresh publication status
refresh_status.description: Re-fetches the skill's status from Yandex Dialogs (one HTTP call). Useful while moderation is in progress to see when the skill flips to on-air.

label_skill_edit_intro.label: Edit the fields below, then click 'Update skill'.

dialog_activation_phrase_2.label: Alternative activation phrase #2 (optional)
dialog_activation_phrase_2.description: Optional. At least 2 words, or leave empty to skip.

dialog_activation_phrase_3.label: Alternative activation phrase #3 (optional)
dialog_activation_phrase_3.description: Optional. At least 2 words, or leave empty to skip.

dialog_activation_phrase_4.label: Alternative activation phrase #4 (optional)
dialog_activation_phrase_4.description: Optional. At least 2 words, or leave empty to skip.

dialog_skill_voice.label: TTS voice
dialog_skill_voice.description: Voice used for the skill's text-to-speech replies.

update_skill.label: Update skill
update_skill.description: Pushes edits to Yandex via PATCH draft + re-deploy. Yandex moderation: 5-15 min.

delete_skill.label: Delete skill
delete_skill.description: Permanently deletes the skill from Yandex Dialogs. Cached Passport sign-in is kept.

cancel_edit.label: Cancel edit
cancel_edit.description: Discards your edits and exits edit mode.

dialog_skill_id.label: Skill ID
dialog_skill_id.description: UUID of the skill — populated automatically after a successful auto-create, or paste manually if you set up the skill yourself.

dialog_skill_token.label: Skill OAuth token (manual setup only)
dialog_skill_token.description: Optional OAuth token from https://oauth.yandex.ru/authorize?response_type=token&client_id=c473ca268cd749d3a8371351a8f2bcbd. Used to push state callbacks to Yandex (future feature; stored encrypted).

dialog_webhook_secret.label: Webhook URL secret
dialog_webhook_secret.description: Random secret embedded in the webhook URL. The full URL is <external_base_url>{0}/<this-secret>. Editable: changes here invalidate Yandex's existing registration.

regenerate_webhook_secret.label: Regenerate webhook secret
regenerate_webhook_secret.description: Generates a fresh secret + resets the auto-create state. The current Yandex skill registration becomes stale — you'll need to re-create the skill.

label_diagnostics_inactive.label: Diagnostics: webhook handler not active — skill_id or webhook_secret missing in saved config. Run Create skill to register a new skill, or paste an existing skill_id + secret in Advanced.

manifest_banner_bundled.label: Skill manifest: bundled default ({0} intents, {1} entities). Use Export to copy it to {2} for editing.

manifest_banner_override.label: Skill manifest: override active at {0} ({1} intents, {2} entities).

manifest_banner_invalid.label: ⚠ Skill manifest: override at {0} is invalid — falling back to bundled default ({1} intents, {2} entities). Error: {3}

manifest_export_exists.label: Manifest override already exists at {0}; the existing file was not overwritten.

manifest_export_write_error.label: Manifest export failed: could not write {0}: {1}

manifest_export_success.label: Manifest exported to {0}. Open the file in an external editor.

manifest_import_empty.label: The manifest paste field is empty; there is nothing to import.

manifest_import_write_error.label: Manifest import failed: could not write {0}: {1}

manifest_reset_absent.label: No manifest override exists; the bundled default is already active.

manifest_reset_delete_error.label: Manifest reset failed: could not delete {0}: {1}

manifest_reset_success.label: Manifest override at {0} was removed; the bundled default is active.

manifest_validate_absent.label: No manifest override exists; there is nothing to validate.

manifest_validate_success.label: ✓ Manifest override is valid ({0} intents, {1} entities).

export_manifest.label: Export manifest
export_manifest.description: Write the current bundled manifest to {0}. Will not overwrite an existing override; use Reset first if you want to start over.

dialog_skill_override_paste.label: Manifest TOML to import
dialog_skill_override_paste.description: Paste the full TOML contents and click Import. If your browser strips line breaks, paste base64 with prefix data:base64,<base64-encoded-TOML> — base64 -i skill.toml will produce one. Cleared on a successful import.

import_manifest.label: Import manifest
import_manifest.description: Validate the pasted TOML and write it to {0}. Existing override is replaced atomically. The paste field is cleared on success.

validate_manifest.label: Validate manifest
validate_manifest.description: Re-parse the override file and report parse / schema errors without re-deploying to Yandex.

reset_manifest.label: Reset manifest
reset_manifest.description: Delete the override file and revert to the bundled default. Idempotent — safe to click when no override exists.

exposed_players.label: Voice-controllable players
exposed_players.description: Players Alice is allowed to control. Leave empty to expose all players known to MA — Alice will then accept voice commands for any player by name.

use_different_instance_name.label: Use a different MA-side instance name
use_different_instance_name.description: By default the Skill name is also used as the instance name shown in MA's provider list. Turn this on to specify a different MA-side name.

instance_name.label: Instance name (MA-side display)
instance_name.description: Display name shown in Music Assistant's provider list. Independent from the Skill name.
